jobs.occupation: Senior Steel Trader (all genders welcome) Global Cross Trading (Leiter/in - Export)
jobs.description: CompanyOperating on a global scale through an international sales and distribution network, tk accelis Trading, formerly thyssenkrupp Materials Trading, is your partner for long-term success. With our local contacts around the world we are represented where the customers need us. Our core capabilities embrace complex logistic services for raw and finished steel materials along with supply chain dependability and consultancy for the downstream manufacturing and metalworking industries.Your responsibilitiesBuild and scale profitable physical steel trading flows, with particular emphasis on cross-border and third-country trading. Sales market focus is EMEA. We are open to candidates trading steel products, including flat products, long products, semi-finished products, or finished goods (steel derivates). More important than a specific product background is a demonstrable ability to originate repeatable, profitable international trade flows.- Leverage in-depth commercial and technical knowledge of steel products and specifications to support profitable trading activities.- Identify, establish, and expand sourcing opportunities and supplier relationships across global markets.- Build, maintain, and strengthen long-term relationships with customers and suppliers on a national and international level.- Manage the full trading cycle, including origination, pricing, negotiation, contracting, execution, receivables management, and PundL accountability.- Develop new procurement and sales channels to drive business growth and increase market penetration.- Collaborate effectively within a multinational environment while utilizing a strong regional and international network to expand business opportunities.- Develop and manage a trading book to achieve agreed volume, gross margin, EBIT, working capital, and risk targets.Your profile- 8+ years of proven experience in physical steel trading with a strong track record of commercial success.- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, combined with a confident and professional presence.- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to drive business growth while operating within corporate governance frameworks.- Strong risk assessment capabilities to support profitable trading decisions.- High level of integrity and thorough understanding of compliance, sanctions, competition law, and reputational risk considerations.- Team-oriented professional with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multinational environment; prior leadership experience is an advantage.- Based in Germany, preferably in Essen, with excellent English language skills; German is a plus.You don’t meet all the criteria in the job advert, but would still like to join tk accelis? We’d look forward to getting to know you!Your benefitsHere at tk accelis Trading, we are a highly globalised, diverse and dynamic team operating in a challenging yet exciting industry. We offer you the following benefits:- A competitive compensation package with performance-related incentives- A wide range of responsibilities within a highly motivated team, where you can shape your role as you see fit- Excellent career prospects and professional development opportunities to help you progress within the companyWe have caught your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application via the ‘Apply Now’ button!ContactLars WollherrSourcing und RecruitingTel: +49 152 01324580We value diversityWe value diversity and therefore welcome all applications, irrespective of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion and beliefs, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity

Saarland University is a campus university with an international reputation for research excellence, particularly in computer science and in the life sciences and nanosciences. electrolytes, and circular recycling strategiesJob requirements and responsibilities: Designing and characterizing novel electrode materials or electrolytes for post-Li technologies Advancing activities of the group and collaboration with external partners Publish scientific papers and present results at international conferencesYour academic qualifications: Completed scientific university studies in Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or relatedfields Language skills (according to GER): English (C1)The successful candidate will also be expected to: Hands-on experience in electrochemistry, material characterization (e.g., XRD, SEM, BET), or process engineeringis advantageous Strong motivation for sustainable technologies and interdisciplinary collaboration Independent, analytical mindset and proficiency in EnglishWhat we can offer you: A flexible work schedule allowing you to balance work and family, among other things the possibility ofteleworking Secure and future-oriented employment with attractive conditions A broad range of further education and professional development programmes (for example language courses) An occupational health management model with numerous attractive options, such as our university sportsprogramme Supplementary pension scheme (RZVK) Discounted tickets on local public transport services (‘Job-Ticket‘ of the saarVV) Job bike leasing (JobRad)We look forward to receiving your meaningful online application (in a PDF file) by 09.11.2026 to ls-energymaterials-jobs@uni-saarland.de. Soldering operatorWorking as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.Your tasks are, amongst others:· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspectionYou will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.What Benchmark has to offer to you:· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.What do we ask of you?· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.· Being able to work very precise and accurate.· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.· Good knowledge of either the Dutch or English language.About Benchmark:Benchmark in Almelo is part of the multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., a listed company in the field of manufacturing electronics and providing services to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).At Benchmark you work for companies that make an impact with their innovations. We develop new products that improve safety or health or increase convenience. These products are supplied from product design to volume production and sometimes directly to the end user. This entire process, from design to production, is carried out entirely in Almelo.Globally, Benchmark Electronics Inc. currently has 23 locations.
